_README: This is BOTH the live footer template AND a sample sheet. The engine reads only: scales, output (legacy top-level sep/segments/surfaces still accepted). output.surfaces.<channel> defines the whole footer for that channel. Every key starting with _ is documentation it ignores. discord reproduces examples/discord_peetie.py and telegram reproduces examples/telegram_peetie2.py as closely as the current verb set allows; see _reconstructions for detail and _gaps for what's not yet expressible.

_contract._doc: The INPUT schema. Every {path} in a text/item resolves against this object (the openclaw.usageLine.v1 contract the plugin pipes in on stdin). Dot-paths only; missing/null/"" → the |fallback (or empty). Built by usage-footer-plugin/index.js buildContract from the reply hook's usageState — when a field is unavailable upstream it arrives null/absent, NOT removed. Each entry: 'type — note'.
_contract.surface: string|null — channel id ("discord"/"telegram"); selects which output.surfaces.<channel> list renders.
_contract.agentId: string|null — flat (not under model) so you can key a per-agent emoji/name map off it.
_contract.model.display_name: string|null — same as id today (no provider prefix stripping; see _gaps lower/basename).
_contract.model.actual: string|null — resolved winner ref (the model actually used).
_contract.model.is_fallback: bool — true when a fallback model was used (🔄).
_contract.model.is_override: bool — true when override_source is set and not ""/"auto" (✏️).
_contract.model.override_source: string|null — what set the override (e.g. session, command).
_contract.context.used_tokens: number|undefined — prompt total occupying the window.
_contract.context.pct_used: number|undefined — 0–100; feed to meter: (meter:1 for one glyph).
_contract.cost.available: bool — whether turn_usd is present (gate the 💲 segment on cost.turn_usd).
_contract.timing.duration_ms: number|null — wall-clock ms for the turn (|dur expects SECONDS, so divide).
_contract.identity.name: string|null — agent display name.
_contract.identity.emoji: string|null — the emoji the agent chose as its marker (the {identity.emoji|🤖} default).
_contract.session.id: string|null — session id (what /usage full now prints).
_contract.limits: object|ABSENT — present only for oauth/mapped providers; absent for api-key/pioneer/unmapped (whole 📊 each-segment then drops). Fields below.
_contract.limits.windows: array — iterate with each; per-window fields below (each item is the loop scope, so reference them bare: {used_pct}, {resets_in_s}).
_contract.limits.windows[].label: string — window name (e.g. "5h", "week"). Per-window styling by label is a _gap.

_consumer_notes._doc: Constraints imposed by the plugin host (usage-footer-plugin/index.js runRenderer), not the engine. Output is .trim()'d and CRLF→LF.
_consumer_notes.max_output_lines: plugins.entries.usage-footer.config.maxOutputLines (default 2; set to 3 here for the telegram 3-line layout). Output with MORE lines than this → the whole footer is rejected and core renders its default. This is the real ceiling on the linebreak trick.
_consumer_notes.max_output_chars: 500 by default — over-length output is rejected.
_consumer_notes.timeout_ms: 1500 by default — slow renderer is killed (SIGTERM→SIGKILL), footer dropped.
_consumer_notes.exit_nonzero: any non-zero exit (incl. our 'no template' rc=1) → core falls back to its own usage line. Fail-open.

scales._doc: Named glyph vocabularies, each ordered low→high (string or list of single glyphs). Reference one by name in a meter: `{value|meter:W:NAME}` tiles a 0–100 value across W cells ([0]=empty, [-1]=full, boundary cell graded); width 1 gives a single glyph. To run high→low, feed a complementary value (e.g. pct_left), pipe |inv (100−value), or add a reversed-order scale.

aliases._doc: Named lookup tables for `{value|alias:TABLE}`. Maps a raw contract value to a short label; any value NOT listed is echoed unchanged (case-insensitive match). List only what you want shortened.

output._doc: The full footer definition, per surface. output.surfaces.<channel> is an ordered list of pieces; the engine renders each, drops empties, and joins survivors with output.sep (default "") to form the final line(s). The CHANNEL'S list IS the whole output — there is no shared top-level layout. surface = contract.surface (the reply channel id). A channel with no entry falls back to output.default (if set), else no custom footer. Embed \n in a piece for multi-line; remember the consumer's maxOutputLines cap (see _consumer_notes).

telegram._target: telegram_peetie2.py — 3 lines: dash / model+ctx / limits. Needs config maxOutputLines>=3.
telegram._approx: no ✓ default status glyph; reasoning not shortened (medium not med); braille bar is left→right not bottom-up; all windows use one scale.

_reconstructions._doc: How your existing footers map onto this template. ✅ = exact, ≈ = close (see note), ❌ = needs a verb/field we don't have yet (see _gaps).

discord_peetie.note: = the active template above. Two gaps: (1) ✓ default glyph needs model.status; (2) per-window emoji SET (5h→weather, week→plants) can't be chosen inside `each` yet — the active template uses `weather` for all windows. See _gaps.

discord_pioneer.note: Identical to peetie BUT (a) limits use the braille limit_meter not emoji → use the `each with meter` item; (b) for the `pioneer`/`pioneer-ai` provider it self-fetches usage from ~/.openclaw/workspace/marvin/projects/ai-cost-tracker-v3/output/pioneer_usage.json. ❌ NOT expressible — a template can only read the contract. Fix: extend the core limits resolver to Pioneer so its windows land in `limits` (then this reconstruction becomes the `each with meter` item).

telegram_peetie2.note: ≈ Same atoms, but it prints THREE lines (— / model+ctx / limits). The engine emits a single line. ❌ multi-line output needs a newline separator / line groups (see _gaps). Single-line telegram works today via surfaces.telegram.

_gaps._doc: What the current verb set CANNOT do, found by reconstructing the real footers. Each is a candidate verb/field for the engine or the contract.
_gaps.model.status (3-way state glyph): ✓/🔄/✏️ is fallback>override>default precedence. Add a derived `model.status` = fallback|override|default to the contract (one buildContract line) → one clean `map`. (Today: separate maps for 🔄/✏️, no ✓.)
_gaps.bottom-up braille meter: The context braille_meter fills 2 columns × 4 dots bottom-up — a different glyph algorithm than a left→right ramp. Needs a meter `style: stack` mode in the engine. (limit_meter, the left→right one, IS reproduced exactly by meter:braille.)
_gaps.per-item scale selection BY LABEL: item_scales selects a scale per window BY POSITION (done). Selecting by the window's `label` instead (so reordering/missing windows stay correct) would still need an item-level label→scale map.
_gaps.non-linear buckets: usage_emoji buckets pct_left at <1/<20/<40/<60/<80. meter:1 is linear. Needs a `bucket:thresholds` verb for exact boundaries (linear meter:1 is a close approximation).
_gaps.lower / basename: short_model strips provider/ and lowercases. The alias verb covers explicit renames; a `lower`+`basename` verb would auto-shorten unlisted provider/model refs without listing each one.
_gaps.multi-line output: telegram_peetie2 is 3 lines. The engine joins to one line. Needs a newline `sep` or line-group support.
_gaps.external data (pioneer): discord_pioneer self-fetches Pioneer usage from an external cache. A template can ONLY read the contract — by design. Fix is to enrich the contract (extend the core limits resolver to Pioneer), not to add a verb.
